rationale: Builds on the 1.5111 staged reverse-tail baseline with a data-order change rather than another scalar sweep. Training rows now start from BOS-anchored document windows with a 512-token stride, so the model sees doc-isolated contexts and interior document positions closer to the final stride-based validation path while preserving fixed MLX shapes, VAL_LOSS_EVERY=0, the recurrent-tail/export setup, and exact final int8+zlib evaluation.
title: Doc-Window Stride Training Loader
